_comment: First-party Farmer's Delight WILD-CROP compat on the MEADOW family (FARMERSDELIGHTPLAN #16). Meadow islands use TOP-LEVEL variants (no overworld biome bands), so this APPENDS one weighted 'wild veg patch' variant (onions/carrots/cabbages). WEIGHT 6 vs the base flowers' summed weight 9 → ~40% of meadow throws roll it (v0.2 fix — the first pass at weight 2 was only ~18%, so crops were too rare to find). Inert without FD: unknown farmersdelight: ids are skipped via Lookup.hasBlock → byte-identical generation. IDS VERIFIED vs FarmersDelight-1.21.1-1.3.2.jar (2026-07-03). Shared verbatim across meadow/meadow_large/huge_meadow (mirror-island-tiers rule); only target differs.
